description: Search normalized live jobs from more than 30 ATS feeds, job boards, and public employment services.

commands: claude mcp add --transport http jobspipe https://mcp.jobspipe.dev/mcp

notes: MCP clients can use the hosted OAuth flow. Scripts and clients without interactive sign-in can send a JobsPipe API key as a bearer token.
Repository, documentation, MIT license, and hosted endpoint authentication response were checked during maintainer review.
